main.description: Set the requester's preferences for its private notifications. Each supplied reason replaces that reason's preference whole; the others are kept. Other keys are ignored. Returns every reason's preference. Separate from app.bsky.notification.putPreferencesV2. Requires auth by a ready community member.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is not an object, or a supplied preference is not an object with include (all or follows), list and push (subscribedPost: list and push; an include given for it is dropped).

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
